en: Repeatedly search for the literal "//import", skip whitespace, verify the next character is '<', locate the matching '>', and copy the text between them into the result vector. The loop stops when no further "//import" is found or the string ends.
ru: Baar baar literal "//import" search karta hai, whitespace skip karta hai, verify karta hai ke next character '<' hai, matching '>' locate karta hai, aur unke darmiyan text ko result vector mein copy kar deta hai. Loop tab rukta hai jab koi aur "//import" na mile ya string khatam ho jaye.

en: Provides an implicit conversion from the current object to a ⟦0⟧.
ru: Current object ko implicitly ⟦0⟧ mein convert karne ki sahulat deta hai.

en: Reverse each word in a character array between given indices.
ru: Diye gaye indices ke darmiyan ek character array mein har word ko reverse karta hai.

en: ⟦0⟧ – minimum operation count, or ⟦1⟧ if impossible.
ru: ⟦0⟧ – minimum operations ki tadaad, ya agar possible na ho to ⟦1⟧.

en: An integer representing the minimum number of steps needed.
ru: Aik integer jo required minimum steps ki tadaad ko represent karta hai.

en: ⟦0⟧ – 2‑D vector of ints representing the matrix; ⟦1⟧ – number of rows; ⟦2⟧ – number of columns.
ru: ⟦0⟧ – ints ka 2-D vector jo matrix represent karta hai; ⟦1⟧ – rows ki tadaad; ⟦2⟧ – columns ki tadaad.

en: vector<vector<int>> – a list of groups, each containing the indices of its members.
ru: vector<vector<int>> – groups ki ek list, har ek mein uske members ke indices.

en: Handle the empty‑list case by creating a single‑node circular list. Otherwise, traverse the list once, distinguishing three scenarios—normal increasing segment, wrap‑around ⟦0⟧, and uniform segment—to locate the proper insertion point, then insert after the identified node. The loop terminates as soon as insertion occurs.
ru: Empty-list case ko ek single-node circular list bana kar handle karta hai. Warna, list ko ek dafa traverse karta hai, teen scenarios ko alag karte hue—normal increasing segment, wrap-around ⟦0⟧, aur uniform segment—taake sahi insertion point dhoonda ja sake, phir identified node ke baad insert kar deta hai. Insertion hote hi loop khatam ho jata hai.

en: Scan A counting odd elements. If none are odd, the answer is 0. Otherwise, any subset that includes at least one odd element yields an odd sum, giving 2^(n‑1) valid ⟦0⟧.
ru: A ko scan karke odd elements count karta hai. Agar koi odd na ho, answer 0 hai. Warna, koi bhi subset jismein kam az kam ek odd element ho odd sum deta hai, jisse 2^(n-1) valid ⟦0⟧ milti hain.

en: Node* node – pointer to the root of ⟦0⟧tree; int key – the key to search for.
ru: Node* node – ⟦0⟧tree ke root ka pointer; int key – woh key jise search karna hai.

en: First, for each start index *k* it calculates remaining width after adding words up to *r*, subtracting one space per extra word. Then it adjusts the remaining ⟦0⟧ to correct the extra space subtraction, marking negative values as infeasible and squaring non‑negative values to obtain the penalty.
ru: Pehly, har start index k ke liye yeh remaining width calculate karta hai jab r tak words add kiye jate hain, aur har extra word ke liye aik space minus karta hai. Phir yeh remaining ⟦0⟧ ko adjust karta hai taake extra space ki subtraction ko correct kiya ja sake, negative values ko infeasible mark karta hai aur non-negative values ko square karke penalty hasil karta hai.

en: Attempt to pop an element into a temporary variable; if the pop succeeds, invoke the functor with that element; finally return the success flag.
ru: Ek element ko ek temporary variable mein pop karne ki koshish karta hai; agar pop succeed ho, us element ke sath functor invoke karta hai; akhir mein success flag return kar deta hai.

en: int n – the integer whose set bits are to be ⟦0⟧.
ru: int n – wo integer jiske set bits ⟦0⟧ kiye jane hain.

en: Compute a prefix‑sum array of candy counts to obtain the total candies up to any type in ⟦0⟧. For each query, check two necessary conditions – (1) the day must be before all candies of earlier types are exhausted, ⟦1⟧ the maximum candies that could be eaten by that day must exceed the total of earlier types. If both hold, the answer is true.
ru: Candy counts ka prefix-sum array calculate karta hai taake ⟦0⟧ mein kisi bhi type tak total candies hasil ki ja saken. Har query ke liye do zaroori conditions check karta hai – (1) day pehle wali tamam types ki candies khatam hone se pehle hona chahiye, ⟦1⟧ us din tak khai ja sakne wali maximum candies pehle wali types ke total se zyada honi chahiye. Agar dono conditions true hon to answer true hota hai.

en: An int representing the smallest possible accumulated sum along such a path.
ru: Aik int jo aisi path par possible sab se chhoti accumulated sum ko represent karta hai.

en: Sort an integer array in ascending order using the selection sort algorithm.
ru: Integer array ko selection sort algorithm use karke ascending order mein sort karta hai.

en: Convert a sorted integer array segment into a height‑balanced binary search tree.
ru: Ek sorted integer array segment ko ek height-balanced binary search tree mein convert karta hai.

en: The function casts the buffer to a ⟦0⟧ and writes each byte of ⟦1⟧ individually, extracting them with bit masks and shifts from least to most significant to achieve little‑endian layout. The caller must ensure the buffer is valid and sufficiently large.
ru: Function buffer ko ⟦0⟧ mein cast karta hai aur ⟦1⟧ ke har byte ko individually write karta hai. Bytes ko bit masks aur shifts ki madad se least significant se most significant tak extract karta hai taake little-endian layout hasil ho. Caller ko ensure karna hoga ke buffer valid aur kafi large ho.

en: The helper toggles an ⟦0⟧ flag on each recursive call, counting a leaf only when the flag is true. It recurses on both children, flips the flag, and returns the larger valid subtree height plus one for the current node, propagating 0 when neither subtree contains a valid node. The public function starts the recursion assuming the root is at odd ⟦1⟧.
ru: Helper har recursive call par ek ⟦0⟧ flag toggle karta hai, sirf tab leaf count karte hue jab flag true ho. Ye dono children par recurse karta hai, flag flip karta hai, aur current node ke liye bara valid subtree height plus one return karta hai, jab dono subtrees mein koi valid node na ho toh 0 propagate karte hue. Public function assume karke ke root odd ⟦1⟧ par hai recursion shuru karta hai.

en: The function uses recursion to reverse the tail of the list, then re‑links the current head after the reversed tail and null‑terminates it. The recursion unwinds, propagating the new head back up. Edge ⟦0⟧ are handled directly.
ru: Ye function recursion istemal karke list ki tail ko reverse karta hai, phir current head ko reversed tail ke baad re-link karta hai aur usay null-terminate kar deta hai. Recursion unwind hote hue naya head upar tak propagate hota hai. Edge cases ⟦0⟧ ko directly handle kiya jata hai.

en: Scan the string once, counting uppercase characters. Then compare the count to the word length and to the special case of a single leading capital to decide validity.
ru: String ko ek dafa scan karta hai, uppercase characters count karte hue. Phir count ko word ki length se aur single leading capital ke special case se compare karke validity decide karta hai.

en: Compute the earliest rotation count that yields the maximum profit for a roller‑coaster.
ru: Ek roller-coaster ke liye maximum profit dene wala sabse pehla rotation count compute karta hai.

en: Initialize the result with the global maximum element to cover all‑negative inputs. Iterate through the array, maintaining a running sum that resets to zero whenever it would become negative, and update the result with the maximum of the current result and the running sum plus the current element. The final result is returned.
ru: All-negative inputs cover karne ke liye result ko global maximum element se initialize karta hai. Array ke through iterate karta hai, ek running sum maintain karte hue jo jab bhi negative hone wala ho zero par reset ho jata hai, aur result ko current result aur running sum plus current element mein se maximum se update karta hai. Final result return kiya jata hai.

en: ⟦0⟧ – ⟦1⟧ if ⟦2⟧ starts with ⟦3⟧, otherwise ⟦4⟧.
ru: ⟦0⟧ – ⟦1⟧ agar ⟦2⟧, ⟦3⟧ se shuru ho, warna ⟦4⟧.

en: If the node is its own parent, it is the root and is returned. Otherwise the function recursively finds the root of the current parent, updates the node’s parent to point directly to that ⟦0⟧, and returns the root.
ru: Agar node apna khud ka parent ho, ye root hai aur return kar diya jata hai. Warna function recursively current parent ka root dhoondta hai, node ke parent ko directly us ⟦0⟧ ki taraf point karne ke liye update karta hai, aur root return kar deta hai.

en: Traverses all indices but only acts when i, j, and k are equal, ⟦0⟧., on the main diagonal. For each such i it XORs the diagonal element and its counterpart mirrored across the last ⟦1⟧. The cumulative XOR is then output.
ru: Tamam indices ko traverse karta hai, lekin sirf tab act karta hai jab i, j aur k barabar hon, yani ⟦0⟧ par. Har aise i ke liye diagonal element aur last ⟦1⟧ ke across mirrored counterpart ka XOR karta hai. Phir cumulative XOR ko output karta hai.

en: Returns the number of class variables defined in a PyrClass object.
ru: Ek PyrClass object mein defined class variables ki tadaad return karta hai.

en: The function directly forwards ⟦0⟧ to the vertex's ⟦1⟧ method, ignoring the ⟦2⟧ argument and assuming ⟦3⟧ is a valid, non‑null handle.
ru: Ye function directly ⟦0⟧ ko vertex ke ⟦1⟧ method mein forward karta hai, ⟦2⟧ argument ko ignore karte hue aur ye assume karte hue ke ⟦3⟧ ek valid, non-null handle hai.

en: ⟦0⟧ copies the input, reverses the copy, and compares. ⟦1⟧ reverses the input, concatenates with the original, and returns the original if it’s a palindrome. reverse manually swaps characters from both ends toward the centre.
ru: ⟦0⟧ input ki copy banata hai, copy ko reverse karta hai aur dono ko compare karta hai. ⟦1⟧ input ko reverse karke original ke sath concatenate karta hai aur agar original palindrome ho to original return karta hai. reverse dono ends ke characters ko manually centre ki taraf swap karta hai.

en: It first finds the opposite covertex index via a mirror mapping, then obtains the neighboring full cell sharing the current covertex, and finally computes the corresponding vertex index in that neighbor to set as the new second covertex. The function returns a Rotor built from these computed components.
ru: Ye pehle ek mirror mapping ke zariye opposite covertex index dhoondta hai, phir current covertex share karne wali neighboring full cell hasil karta hai, aur akhir mein us neighbor mein corresponding vertex index compute karta hai naye second covertex ki tarah set karne ke liye. Function in computed components se bana ek Rotor return karta hai.

en: Writes the opening token, then loops over all data ranges, inserting commas between them, appends each range, and finally adds a closing parenthesis before returning the stream.
ru: Opening token likhta hai, phir sab data ranges par loop karta hai, unke darmiyan commas insert karte hue, har range append karta hai, aur akhir mein stream return karne se pehle ek closing parenthesis add kar deta hai.

en: Concatenate the host API ⟦0⟧ and the device name into a single string.
ru: Host API ⟦0⟧ aur device ke naam ko ek single string mein concatenate karta hai.

en: For each possible start index, compute the initial difference and extend the slice forward while the difference remains constant, counting each successful extension as a distinct slice. The inner loop breaks as soon as the difference changes, ensuring ⟦0⟧ time in the worst case.
ru: Har possible start index ke liye, initial difference compute karta hai aur slice ko forward extend karta hai jab tak difference constant rahe, har successful extension ko ek distinct slice ke tor par count karte hue. Difference change hote hi inner loop break ho jata hai, jisse worst case mein ⟦0⟧ time ensure hota hai.

en: Recursively prints all words stored in a 26‑branch trie.
ru: 26-branch trie mein stored tamam words ko recursively print karta hai.

en: ⟦0⟧ – the source string; ⟦1⟧ – number of characters to examine (may be ≤ ⟦2⟧()).
ru: ⟦0⟧ – source string; ⟦1⟧ – examine karne wale characters ki tadaad (⟦2⟧() se kam ya barabar ho sakti hai).

en: Initializes a counter, then performs two nested loops each iterating n times, incrementing the counter on every inner iteration, resulting in n² total increments.
ru: Aik counter initialize karta hai, phir do nested loops perform karta hai jo dono n times iterate karte hain. Har inner iteration par counter ko increment karta hai, jis ke result mein total n² increments hoti hain.

en: To perform an in-order traversal of a binary tree and update each node's value to be the sum of itself and all nodes visited so far in reverse order.
ru: Ek binary tree ki in-order traversal perform karne aur har node ki value ko khud aur reverse order mein ab tak visit kiye gaye sab nodes ke sum se update karne ke liye.

en: Terminates any active parallel addition operations and releases associated resources.
ru: Koi bhi active parallel addition operations ko terminate karta hai aur associated resources release kar deta hai.

en: A pointer ⟦0⟧ of type ⟦1⟧ pointing to the node to be deleted.
ru: ⟦1⟧ type ka pointer ⟦0⟧ jo delete kiye jane wale node ki taraf point karta hai.

en: Compute the number of ways to tile a 2×N board with ⟦0⟧ modulo 1e9+7.
ru: ⟦0⟧ (L-shaped trominoes samet) se ek 2×N board ko tile karne ke tareeqon ki tadaad modulo 1e9+7 compute karta hai.

en: ⟦0⟧ – total fuel cost, where each traversed edge costs one unit of fuel per car used.
ru: ⟦0⟧ – total fuel cost, jahan har traversed edge har istemal ki gayi car ke liye ek unit fuel cost karta hai.

en: Determine if n new flowers can be planted in a flowerbed without violating the no-adjacent-flowers rule.
ru: Ye determine karta hai ke n naye phool ek flowerbed mein no-adjacent-flowers rule violate kiye baghair plant kiye ja sakte hain ya nahi.

en: an ⟦0⟧ representing the sum of profits earned by all workers under an optimal assignment.
ru: Aik ⟦0⟧ jo optimal assignment ke tehat tamam workers ke earned profits ka sum represent karta hai.

en: Generate and print a permutation of the numbers 1..N with a specific “alternating‑ends” pattern.
ru: 1..N numbers ki aik permutation generate aur print karta hai jismein specific “alternating-ends” pattern follow hota hai.

en: First collect all substrings of ⟦0⟧ with length ≤ k into a set. Then, for each length from 1 to k, generate candidate strings in lexicographic ⟦1⟧ and return the first one not in the set; if none exist, return “-1”.
ru: Sab se pehle ⟦0⟧ ke tamam substrings jin ki length k se kam ya barabar ho, unhein set mein collect karta hai. Phir 1 se k tak har length ke liye lexicographic ⟦1⟧ mein candidate strings generate karta hai aur pehli aisi string return karta hai jo set mein na ho. Agar koi na mile to "-1" return karta hai.

en: ⟦0⟧ cw – a value representing the desired FPU control ⟦1⟧.
ru: ⟦0⟧ cw – ek value jo desired FPU control ⟦1⟧ ko represent karti hai.

en: An int representing the majority ⟦0⟧.
ru: Ek int jo majority ⟦0⟧ represent karta hai.

en: Iterate rows; for even rows, append elements at columns 0,2,4,…; for odd rows, begin at the rightmost column that matches the same ⟦0⟧ and append elements stepping left by two. The resulting sequence follows a left‑to‑right then right‑to‑left “zig‑zag” across rows.
ru: Rows par iterate karta hai; even rows ke liye, columns 0,2,4,… par elements append karta hai; odd rows ke liye, us rightmost column se shuru karta hai jo same ⟦0⟧ se match kare aur do se left steps karte hue elements append karta hai. Resulting sequence rows ke across left-to-right phir right-to-left "zig-zag" follow karta hai.

en: Replaces the current node’s contents with new data and child links.
ru: Current node ke contents ko naye data aur child links se replace karta hai.

en: The function records the original size, sorts and deduplicates the array, then scans it with a sliding‑window idea: it counts the longest subsequence where the difference between the first and current element does not exceed ⟦0⟧. The answer is the original size minus this longest subsequence length.
ru: Ye function original size record karta hai, array ko sort aur deduplicate karta hai, phir ek sliding-window idea se scan karta hai: ye us sabse lambi subsequence ko count karta hai jahan first aur current element ka farq ⟦0⟧ se zyada na ho. Answer original size mein se is sabse lambi subsequence length ko minus karke milta hai.

en: The function sorts the input points based on their Euclidean distance from the origin (calculated as ⟦0⟧). The sorting uses a lambda function for comparison. After sorting, it returns the first K elements from the sorted list.
ru: Ye function input points ko origin se unki Euclidean distance ke hisab se sort karta hai (jo ⟦0⟧ se calculate hoti hai). Sorting comparison ke liye ek lambda function istemal karti hai. Sort hone ke baad, sorted list se pehle K elements return karta hai.

en: Scan the array once, remembering the index of the last encountered 1. When a new 1 is found, compute the number of elements between it and the previous 1; if this count is less than k, return false immediately. If the scan finishes without violation, return true.
ru: Array ko ek dafa scan karta hai, last encountered 1 ka index yaad rakhte hue. Jab ek naya 1 mile, uske aur pichle 1 ke darmiyan elements ki tadaad compute karta hai; agar ye count k se kam ho, turant false return kar deta hai. Agar scan bina violation ke khatam ho jaye, true return karta hai.

en: Compute a prime‑lookup table up to the string length using the Sieve of Eratosthenes, count each character’s frequency with an unordered map, then iterate the original string, appending characters whose frequency is not marked prime.
ru: Sieve of Eratosthenes istemal karke string length tak ek prime-lookup table compute karta hai, ek unordered map se har character ki frequency count karta hai, phir original string par iterate karta hai, un characters ko append karte hue jinki frequency prime mark nahi hui.

en: int – number of length‑k substrings that can be permuted into a palindrome.
ru: int – length-k substrings ki tadaad jinhe palindrome mein permute kiya ja sakta hai.

en: For each element, calculate its “maximized” (bits shifted left) and “minimized” (bits packed right) forms. Evaluate two patterns—(max, min, max, …) ⟦0⟧—summing values at even and odd positions, then return the greater absolute difference.
ru: Har element ke liye, iski "maximized" (bits shifted left) aur "minimized" (bits packed right) forms calculate karta hai. Do patterns evaluate karta hai—(max, min, max, …) ⟦0⟧—even aur odd positions par values sum karte hue, phir bara absolute difference return karta hai.

en: Allocate a temporary character buffer sized for the decimal representation, fill it with ⟦0⟧, insert the buffer into the stream, then deallocate the buffer.
ru: Decimal representation ke liye ek temporary character buffer size karke allocate karta hai, use ⟦0⟧ se fill karta hai, buffer ko stream mein insert karta hai, phir buffer deallocate kar deta hai.

en: two ints l and r – the inclusive range ⟦0⟧.
ru: Do ints l aur r – inclusive range ⟦0⟧.

en: Writes the formatted help text to ⟦0⟧; returns nothing.
ru: Formatted help text ko ⟦0⟧ mein likhta hai; kuch return nahi karta.

en: Brute‑force iterate x and y from 1 to 1000, evaluate ⟦0⟧, and collect pairs matching z. The result is returned after the full search.
ru: x aur y ko 1 se 1000 tak brute-force iterate karta hai, ⟦0⟧ evaluate karta hai, aur z se match hone wale pairs collect karta hai. Full search ke baad result return kiya jata hai.

en: Compute the minimum number of character changes required to split a string into at most k semi‑palindromic substrings.
ru: Ek string ko zyada se zyada k semi-palindromic substrings mein split karne ke liye zaroori minimum character changes compute karta hai.

en: Determines whether a pair of ⟦0⟧ satisfies a predefined set of rules.
ru: Ye determine karta hai ke ⟦0⟧ ka ek pair ek predefined set of rules satisfy karta hai ya nahi.

en: Prints a sequence formed by the most‑ and least‑significant digits of N^1 … N^X.
ru: N^1 … N^X ke most- aur least-significant digits se bani ek sequence print karta hai.
